text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Yuki-chan! 
Cafe collapsed, right? ...How is she 
doing?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...She's fast asleep right now. 
The doctor said it's probably 
exhaustion..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ............I'm such a fool.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I was right beside her the whole time... 
yet I didn't notice till she collapsed... 
I'm truly a blockhead... If only I'd been 
payin' closer attention, Cafe-san wouldn't 
have..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Don't blame yourself, Yuki-chan. 
We didn't notice either, so we're just as 
much at fault."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"If you get all down in the dumps, won't 
that make Cafe sad too? She'll feel 
terrible thinking she made you cry when 
she never meant to."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...! Y-You're right... It might make her 
feel guilty. 
Cafe-san is so kind, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Right?! ...So, let's put our heads 
together! What can we do to put a smile on 
Cafe's face? To help her truly relax and 
rest easy!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, nothing comes to mind for me right 
off the bat, but... what about you, 
Yuki-chan? I'm sure you'd know!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"After all, you're the one who's been 
closest to Cafe!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"......! 
You're... right, aren't you...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe... You're right, Ticket-san. 
Now's no time to be mopin' around!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's the spirit, that's the 
spirit! 
...Fufufu, you're always at your best when 
you're smiling, Yuki-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe-san! You're awake! 
...Are you feeling alright?!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "...Would you like some tea?!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
It's delicious..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, really?! Oh, thank goodness! 
It might be clumsy, but I tried makin' it 
myself from scratch."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"It has a very... gentle taste... 
............"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It has been a while, hasn't it? 
Having... tea together like this..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...It really has.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. Thank you so much, Cafe-san. 
For always helping me out—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I think about it, ever since we 
met, 
I've done nothin' but rely on you, 
Cafe-san..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's not true............ If anything...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I just couldn't help but feel energy 
welling up inside me. 
Because you and everyone else lent me a 
hand."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Comin' up with one sparkly Valentine's 
wagashi after another. 
Hypin' up the customers with the 
sweet-off."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I thought, we won't lose to any of the 
amazin' shops around here! 
And the more I thought that, the more 
settled my nerves got. I just felt an 
endless supply of energy bouncin' up."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Like, I'm gonna give it everything I've 
got! 
Bring on whatever troubles come our way! 
...Or somethin' like that, haha."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
...That sounds... just like you, 
Yukino-san."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...And... that strength is just like you, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, havin' a tough body is my best 
trait, after all! 
Leave it to me!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"(...Right. Why did I forget...? 
Yukino-san is... like a lone flower 
blooming on a rocky mountain...)"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"(Swaying gracefully in the strong wind... 
and turning to face the sun once more. 
...The more you sway... the more 
beautifully you shine, don't you?)"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, Cafe-san... about the shop. 
Would you... from now on, too...?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Please, let me help you again. 
To be your support, Yukino-san—no."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Let us do it together, Yukino-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "!! Thank you so much, Cafe-san!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, um... there's one thing that 
crossed my mind. 
Just now, while having tea with you, 
Cafe-san... I remembered."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"The taste from when I was little— 
the one I told you about, Cafe-san..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"How should I put it? That... 
indescribably happy taste from back then. 
I really want to recreate it."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I want to make a wagashi that can make 
people feel the way I felt back then.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"(...I know it. That taste is... 
one we have also... savored together many 
times...)"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"(...An indescribable taste of 
happiness—)"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"A peaceful moment... with someone 
precious to you. 
A sweet... made to spend such a time 
together, is it...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah?! Th-That's it! 
That's exactly the kind of sweet I wanted 
to make...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"As expected of Cafe-san! 
I couldn't put it into words at all and 
was strugglin' so hard...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
...It's nothing impressive at all."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It is only because you were there. ...That 
is all.
